newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan interbank rate sinks at mid-session.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan interbank rate sinks at mid-session.

text.p: Taiwan's interbank rate sank at mid-session on Monday, with the market lacking strong demand for liquidity, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate was at 4.509 percent against Thursday's pre-holiday close of 4.653, with 30-day commercial paper staying unchanged at 4.75-5.80. Dealers expected the rates to remain steady in the near term.
The bond market was quiet in morning trade, with the 10-year 84/1 bond yield at 5.6800 against 5.6750.
The markets were closed on Friday and Saturday due to national holidays. -- Julie Hu (5080815)
